sources.title: SpaceXAI: Grok 4.7 for coding and knowledge work (Sep 21)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: SpaceXAI released Grok 4.7 on Sep 21 for coding and knowledge work with a larger base model than 4.6, longer RL on harder multi-hour mixes, native Grok Bot harness understanding, and a new safeguard stack; available in Cursor all tiers, Grok Build free, Grok API, routers/clouds.
Priced $2 input / $6 output per 1M, same as 4.6; fast variant 2x speed at 2x price.

Vendor-run benchmarks with disclosed effort asymmetry (4.7 xhigh vs 4.6 high vs Sol max vs Fable max): CursorBench 4.0 46.3%; DeepSWE 71.0% high-effort; Terminal-Bench 4.0 37.6% internal harness; GDPval 1695 Elo xhigh.
claims.context: Effort-asymmetric vendor table; third-party checks mixed (Vals Index costs; Artificial Analysis Terminal-Bench 26% vs internal 38% harness discrepancy).

limitations.text: "Larger base / longer RL / harness-awareness" lack independently checkable artifacts.
